summary: Chicago dossiers are mostly sound on long-established history, and consistent with CURRENT FACTS on coach, roster, Cup group, no opening-night or Christmas game and last season. Three live spot-checks found real errors: Angel Reese was traded from the Sky to Atlanta in April 2026, Saint Alfred closed its Wicker Park store in April 2026, and RSVP Gallery appears to be in the West Loop, not Wicker Park. Fixed in place: the false Ashland L stop as arena access, Honey Dijon and Abloh origins, a bogus 'Jungle' vocab term, the flag-blue hex conflict, Cup Night dates, and several oddly specific details. The strategy brief still needs the editor to drop Saint Alfred, fix Ashland, reconcile impossible near-term timing (mural and drops within days of Oct 7), and stop calling Mac Irvin Fire and Notre Nike-owned.
